hero_mode.label: Hero
hero_mode.help: What sits at the top of the discussion list. The sky follows each visitor's own clock, or stays on one time of day.
hero_mode.clock: Sky that follows each visitor's clock
hero_mode.fixed: Sky at one time of day

hero_scene.label: Time of day for a fixed sky

hero_image.label: Picture address
hero_image.help: A picture for the hero (https). With a video, it is also shown before the video plays, and instead of it for visitors who reduce motion or save data.

hero_video.label: Video address
hero_video.help: A short muted loop (https, MP4 or WebM). It never plays for visitors who reduce motion or save data.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.help: Buttons, links and highlights. Members can pick their own in the paint shop.

tag_strip.label: Tag tiles on the discussion list

radar.label: Show who is online
radar.help: A radar under the navigation. Everyone sees how many are online; faces show only to visitors allowed to search members, and never for members who hide their online status.

player_cards.label: Player cards
player_cards.help: With Renown, an XP ring and level around each post author's avatar, XP to the next level on profiles, and a rank road above a member's posts.

paint_shop.label: Paint shop
paint_shop.help: Lets visitors pick their own accent, sky, density and motion on their device.

profile_sky.label: Members pick their profile sky
profile_sky.help: The time of day shown behind a member's profile card, seen by everyone who visits it.

hud.label: Phone bar
hud.help: A bottom bar on phones with Home, Tags, New, Alerts and your profile. It stays off when Mobile Tab is installed.
